notes.title: Discovery Update! (v1.2)
notes.content:
Hey folks!

I'm excited to announce version 1.2, or as we're calling it, the Discovery Update! We want players to discover all the hilarious, cool, or plain random moments that happen in the world of boggdrop, so we've come up with some new achievements as a little incentive! Plus we've made some changes in response to feedback and have fixed some bugs.

Changelist:
[list]
[*]Added [url=http://steamcommunity.com/stats/363240/achievements]12 new achievements[/url]! Including 4 "Gold", 4 "Silver", and 4 "Bronze" achievements. Take some screenshots, we want to see your adventures!
[*]You can now combine the flaming rocks and double/triple rock rewards for extra ridiculous power
[*]In the caveman overview screen, you can now right click on the task icons to make units of the selected type unfollow Craig (was actually in a previous update for Windows but intended for this one).
[*]The 2nd player can now be controlled by keyboard as well as game controller, or have those keys mapped to an otherwise unsupported controller (was actually in a previous update for Windows but intended for this one). [url=http://paraboxgames.com/controller.pdf]More details[/url]!
[/list]
Plus some tweaks & fixes..
[list][*]Summit Showdown no longer skips first opponent.
[*]Fixed a bug with one of the cheat.
[*]Fixed crashes caused by engine update in 1.1c
[*]Tweaked the difficulty in 1st level (if you haven't finished that level yet, now's a good time to give it another crack!)
[*]Fixed glitch with spacing between characters in in-game text.

Now's a great time to pickup Caveman Craig and give in to your instinctual urges to thump dinosaurs!

(Full article: [url=http://paraboxgames.com/caveman-craig-discovery-update/]click here![/url])

-Rhys

notes.title: New update!
notes.content:
If you're running Windows, Caveman Craig has just been updated to 1.1c, which should fix the crashes caused by a recent Steam update*. If you're running Mac, you'll need to stick to 1.1b for a little while longer while we sort some stuff out.

1.1c also brings some new features and other bug fixes!

- The micro-managing bunch of you can now right click on group tasks in the overview window to make units of that type unfollow Craig!
- We improved controller support.. and..
- The 2nd player can now be controlled by the keyboard, OR have keys mapped to a non-supported controller via third party software (more info on this very soon!).
- The "Great Balls of Fire" achievement now only requires you to reach stage 3, not 4, of meteor dodge.
- Fixed crash that can occur when saving the game with additional bedspace.
- Fixed bug when playing Raptor's Revenge a second time.

We have yet another update in the pipeline featuring a bunch of new achievements to sink your teeth into, and some other bits and pieces!

* If you are still unable to launch Caveman Craig, please post on the pinned thread in the discussions board!

notes.title: Update 1.1 now out!
notes.content:
About grokkin' time!
We just released an update to Caveman Craig for both Windows & Mac to fix some bugs and things. Thanks for your patience!

[b]Main things[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed random freezes that occur mostly in Survival mode, but sometimes in Conquest (normal) mode too.
[*]Improved controller support for co-op, check the release note below.
[/list]

[b]Other things[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now correctly take Steam screenshots with F12!
[*]Global leaderboards now correctly show the top 5 scores (click that icon above the rankings to change from friends to global)
[*]Fixed rare issue when Craig finishes digesting a mushroom. It goes down the wrong way.
[*]Tweaked difficulty of the first two levels, just a wee bit! 
[*]Made various tweaks that will decrease the chances of the game freezing (possibly to zero).
[/list]

[b]Release Note[/b]
Caveman Craig only supports HiD compatible controllers. As a general rule, Xbox controllers should work on both Windows & Mac without additional software or drivers, but PlayStation controllers require third party drivers such as SCP or DS3tool. We are looking at adding support to share a keyboard, which would also allow you to map your gamepad to keyboard keys using 3rd party software as a compatibility option.

[b]Encounter a problem?[/b]
You can post on the discussion group here, or e-mail us at support@paraboxgames.com . If you encounter an error, take a screenshot or copy the error message. If the issue relates to loading a game, consider sending us the save file before overwriting it with a new one.

Rawr!
-Rhys

notes.title: The Secrets of Boggdrop..
notes.content:
The land of boggdrop is a primitive place, but it's by no means lacking in things to do and encounter.

Here are some things you can achieve in Caveman Craig.. if you're crazy enough..
[list]
[*]Build towers, catapults, and rock stompers to defend your tribe from dinosaur invasions.
[*]Have a mushroom skirmish!
[*]Encounter a T-rex nest, and soil yourself accordingly.
[*]Become the jurassic equivalent of a "cat lady" and breed a massive family of pet dinosaurs.
[*]Start the zombie apocalypse (65 million years early).
[*]Plug in a controller and play split screen co-op with a friend. If your mate isn't in kicking distance, it's not truly multiplayer.
[*]Sabotage enemy tribes by placing stinky meat in their land to attract dinosaurs.
[*]Blow up walruses.
[*]Meet every cave-child's hero, "Barno the Dinosaur". Then blow him up too.
[*]Collect valuable dino-bird feathers to give to Tutorial Guy (your best friend).
[*]Play survival mode, and see how big you can grow your tribe before you're overrun by dinosaurs!
[/list]
.. And heaps more!

Caveman Craig comes out on the 28th of August. 

"A love letter to strategy favourites like Age of Empires, Worms, or Theme Hospital, and to the thrilling concept of man meeting dinosaur."
